opportunities.effect: Moves offline work off the board critical path; duration not inferable from app receipts.

opportunities.action: Reuse already captured settled launcher tree for the first exact icon lookup; no intervening UI action; retain raw tree and selected-icon intent.
opportunities.risk: Low; exact package/activity match and launcher focus gate unchanged. Do not click a stale coordinate.

opportunities.action: Next-run transport batching: retain host held check; combine boot equality with the actual shell operation and its explicit remote RC. Batch independent read-only ps/window or metadata queries with separate output sections.
opportunities.risk: Preserve command allowlist, serial, fail-closed remote statuses, and no automatic write retry. No caching across boot or write boundaries.

opportunities.action: Use observed launcher page signature/search-direction hints; each actual click still requires a fresh exact icon tree and original focus gate.
opportunities.risk: Do not borrow5ea page positions for61b. Edge detection must distinguish a failed/no-op swipe from animation delay. Quantified swipe time is only an upper bound.

opportunities.action: Run local decode/triage/hilog parsing and artifact source preparation concurrently with board waiting; preserve all raw pulls before next app resets hilog.
opportunities.risk: No concurrent UI apps on the same board; do not postpone hilog capture past reset.
